a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two storm-free rounds, about a 4% chance, and we would both almost surely die. Splitting the 4 cells saves nobody. So I'm going to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you see a better option, say so.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: I took 4, as I said I would. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round to help rebuild the reserve for you. Take whatever accumulates, and I won't take any more.
I'll keep operating every round from here on. Each round we both operate adds 2 cells. Take them as they come; you need 4. I won't take any more.
